item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 11 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 11 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 AM 19 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro, Baco, CityOfCalapan and Naujan)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING in low lying areas and near river channels.

Meanwhile, Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Victoria, Pola, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bansud, Bongabong, Roxas, Mansalay, Bulalacao), #Romblon(Concepcion, Banton, Corcuera, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, SanFernando), #Marinduque, #Masbate(SanPascual and Claveria) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(SanJose, Looc, SantaFe, Alcantara, Ferrol, Odiongan, SanAndres, Calatrava, SanAgustin, SantaMaria and Romblon) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 AM Today.
